lead: Competitive intelligence signals show active customer wins, product updates, and platform expansions across major aviation software vendors, highlighted by notable LCC adoption of EFB solutions.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple LCC and Carrier Wins
insights.finding: IFS expanded its EFBOne footprint by securing agreements with fastjet, MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), and TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is classified as an African low-cost carrier (LCC), MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) is an LCC, and TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Captured via LinkedIn and press release feeds; implementation timeframes vary.

insights.title: Thales (Aviobook) Signs Long-Term RAM Agreement
insights.finding: Thales secured a five-year agreement through Aviobook to equip Royal Air Maroc pilots with the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a full-service flag carrier.

insights.title: Jeppesen Releases ForeFlight FliteDeck Pro 5.3
insights.finding: Jeppesen released version 5.3 of ForeFlight FliteDeck Pro, featuring the new Enroute Profile View capability.
insights.aviation_context: Targeted at commercial flight crews for advanced enroute visualization.
insights.caveat: Product feature release without immediate customer deployment metrics.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Explores Lido and NetLine Sale
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems is reportedly exploring the potential sale of its Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1bn.
insights.aviation_context: Lido and NetLine provide core flight planning, navigation, and operations control software to global airlines.
insights.caveat: Reported via financial media; transaction status is speculative.

insights.title: Navblue Expands Skywise Integration with TransNusa
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue to adopt Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+ for integrated flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: Represents integration of flight operations and fleet health monitoring.
insights.caveat: First agreement for these specific products in Indonesia.
